excerpt.zh:
又来。一样的浪费，一样的结果。

我把你们所消耗的还给了你们，不是为了伤害你们，而是让你们感受到它的分量。事不过三。我不想看到你们再一次浪费自我。
excerpt.en:
Again. The same waste, the same result.

I return what you spent, not to hurt you, but so you feel the weight of it. Learn from this. I will not watch you spend yourself a third time.
